step1.title: Welcome to Allergy Scan
step1.description: Scan food labels to instantly check if your allergens are included.

step2.title: Select your allergens
step2.description: Select at least one allergen to monitor. You can change this later in settings.

step3.title: Partial containment warnings
step3.description: Configure whether to warn about "partially contains" labeling patterns for your selected allergens.

step4.title: Please read before using
step4.disclaimer: This app's judgment is for reference only. If you are at risk of allergy symptoms or anaphylaxis, always check the actual label before purchasing.
step4.important1: Do not rely 100% on this app's judgment
step4.important2: Always check the actual label before purchasing
step4.important3: Consult a medical professional if you have symptoms

restore.title: Restore with backup code
restore.description: Enter the backup code issued on your previous device

error.code_invalid: Invalid code. It may have expired or already been used.
